rationale: The stock is in a no-trade location in both directions: it is firmly below session VWAP ($19.34) and the 5m 9-EMA after a failed morning recovery (high $19.77 rejected, grind to within 0.8% of the low), which argues against longs, but shorting a name already down 16% while it sits on the day's low carries heavy squeeze-bounce risk with only ~0.3 ATR of stop room before obvious resistance at $18.63-18.70. The most recent 1-minute bounce died on declining volume with no capitulation spike or reversal signature, and with no identifiable catalyst, a risk-off tape (SPY -0.78%, VIXY +2.72%), and midday hours remaining, neither continuation nor mean-reversion has a measurable edge. Standing aside until price either reclaims VWAP (long trigger) or breaks and holds below $18.35 (short trigger) is the higher-expectancy action.
